dedupe_keys.name: fao gridded livestock of the world 2010 totals corrected density layers

description: This dataset gives livestock density layers for cattle, sheep, goats, pigs and chickens around 2010. The Zenodo record says the layers come from multivariate regression modelling of sub-national survey and census data from 1995 to 2015, are totals-corrected so densities within each census polygon match the reported totals, and were produced for the Agriculture Division of the Food and Agriculture Organization in Rome. It was deposited in May 2024 by William Wint of the Environmental Research Group Oxford under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip of about 2.9 GB. Coverage is global. Caveats: resolution and file format are not stated on the page read, and densities are modelled. For simulation it gives gridded animal numbers to estimate livestock exposure to drought, floods, heat and disease and to size feed and meat supply chains. Related catalogue records include the Global Pasture Watch livestock census samples.
